steps.name: sync-exact-head
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch origin main; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "c6bf72310289c88b9644723ce8635c5288cad6f6"; git checkout -B main origin/main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "c6bf72310289c88b9644723ce8635c5288cad6f6"

steps.name: recover-and-verify-s22-adb
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; rm -f /tmp/aicall-s22-selector; adb start-server >/dev/null; pick(){ for D in $(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); do M="$(adb -s "$D" shell getprop ro.product.model 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')"; S="$(adb -s "$D" shell getprop ro.serialno 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')"; if [ "$M" = SM-S906B ] && [ "$S" = RFCT70L7E8J ]; then printf '%s' "$D"; return 0; fi; done; return 1; }; SEL="$(pick || true)"; if [ -z "$SEL" ]; then for E in $(adb mdns services 2>/dev/null | awk '/_adb-tls-connect\._tcp/ {print $NF}'); do adb connect "$E" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done; sleep 2; SEL="$(pick || true)"; fi; test -n "$SEL"; printf '%s' "$SEL" >/tmp/aicall-s22-selector; KIND=direct; case "$SEL" in *:*) KIND=wireless;; esac; printf 's22_adb_ready=true\nselector_kind=%s\n' "$KIND"

steps.name: build-proof-apks
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; if [ -d "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" ]; then export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; elif [ -d "$HOME/Android/Sdk" ]; then export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Android/Sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; else echo 'android_sdk_not_found=true' >&2; exit 1; fi; printf 'android_sdk_ready=true\n'; ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug :app:assembleDebugAndroidTest --no-daemon

steps.name: install-and-run-redacted-proof
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; SERIAL="$(cat /tmp/aicall-s22-selector)"; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/androidTest/debug/app-debug-androidTest.apk >/dev/null; OUT="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am instrument -w -r -e class pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.identity.AndroidPhoneEnrollmentDisclosureContractTest pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner)"; printf '%s
' "$OUT"; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q '^OK (1 test)' || { printf 'phone_enrollment_s22_proof=false
' >&2; exit 1; }; printf 'phone_enrollment_s22_proof=true
'

steps.name: leave-app-ready
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; SERIAL="$(cat /tmp/aicall-s22-selector)"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell monkey -p pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; printf 'main_activity_opened=true\nreal_phone_not_transported=true\n'
